apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 170 (1.1.170) unlocks full 120 FPS displayed framerate on iPhone ProMotion: removes presentation deadline scheduling that delayed drawable release in QuartzCore, and upgrades the pipeline to triple buffering (3 GPU slots, 3 semaphore permits, CAMetalLayer.maximumDrawableCount = 3, MTKView.preferredFramesPerSecond = 120). Retains controller rumble and split touchpad. Unsigned Release IPA for KravaSigner.
